scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.build:sqlite: node -e "if (process.platform === 'linux') { require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix server rebuild sqlite3 --build-from-source', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm run build:sqlite && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
